svg.text: Clean once, before any task saves a position in the leaf
Tasks keep leaf positions as ranks. Compacting expired entries changes ranks, so a leaf is compacted on its first visit in a batch and stamped with the batch
number; later arrivals in the same batch see the stamp and share the same rank mapping. Empty leaves stay linked until every task has finished.
1 Three arrivals at the same leaf in batch 42
reclaimCV = 20: entries with cv ≤ 20 are expired and still physically present
a rank saved now would shift when they go
first arrival: stamp 41 ≠ 42 → cleanReadLeaf: drop a and e, compact ranks, stamp 42, then save a rank
ranks 0, 1, 2; the same mapping for the rest
of batch 42: no write or reclamation interleaves
positions saved against the cleaned leaf
rank 1 (g): first write at or after its read begin; scan starts here
rank 0 (c): continues its scan from the first entry; stamp 42 seen, no second compaction
prevRank = count = 3, exclusive: the first inspected rank is 2 (k); stamp 42 seen
Had T2 or T3 arrived first, it would have done the compaction; what matters is that it happens once, before any rank is saved, and that every later arrival maps ranks the same way.
2 A leaf that becomes empty stays in the chain until traversal ends
L2 · all entries expired, compacted to empty
two tasks met L2 and both queued it: duplicates are allowed
An empty leaf is not released while tasks run: a task may hold a rank in it, a parent bound above it, or be about to arrive from a neighbor. Releasing it now would
break saved positions and the chain; cleanPending runs only when resident, new and suspended tasks are all finished.
after traversal: cleanPending drains the queue, allocating nothing
unlink L2 from the chain, remove its entry from the parent, release the block: its node generation is cleared
skipped: the node it named is gone, and its block may already be in the free list
L1 and L3 are now neighbors; empty ancestors are removed the same way
and the root is normalized. Nothing is allocated during the drain, so a
released block is not reused before the queue is empty.
Why the stamp, and why the queue
Ranks are positions in order[] after compaction; two tasks that saw different compactions of the same leaf would disagree about which entry a rank names.
The stamp makes the first visit of a batch the only one that compacts, and the fixed cutoff plus the absence of writes keeps the cleaned ranks stable afterwards.
Structural release is deferred for the same reason: saved ranks, parent bounds and leaf links must outlive every task that may use them.
